## Related issue

Closes #

Required: an issue a maintainer has labelled `accepted`, bug fixes included. A PR without one, or a third open PR from the same person, is closed automatically. See CONTRIBUTING.md → Pull requests.

## Problem

Describe the problem and how to reproduce it.

## Changes

Describe what changed and why it solves the problem.

## Proof

List the commands or steps used to verify the change and their results. For UI changes, include screenshots or a recording.

## Limitations

List anything not tested, known failures, or environments not covered.

## Checklist

- [ ] This PR is linked to an issue labelled `accepted`.
- [ ] I searched existing issues and pull requests for duplicates.
- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated work.
- [ ] I updated the relevant documentation.
- [ ] I ran the checks required by `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I did not claim anything as verified without testing it appropriately.
- [ ] I reviewed and take responsibility for any AI-assisted code or text.
